vi-GTl0.title: Houses: mixed old European styles, arches
vi-GTl0.summary: A blend of European styles (Renaissance, Spanish Baroque, Rococo, Victorian). Look for facades with large arches, central plazas and courtyards.

vi-Ij8c.title: Google car: white, no antenna
vi-Ij8c.summary: A white car with no antenna on the roof. Seen on the southern island, but less often than the red truck.

vi-LB6O.title: Coverage: boat trekker, blue water, hills
vi-LB6O.summary: Two boat trekkers on the north coast of the southern island. You can't see the boat, but you see blue water and hilly islands. Near the national park the picture has a pink tint.

vi-Nfmm.title: Sign: Danish street names like -gade
vi-Nfmm.summary: Some streets keep Danish names ending in -gade, or have bilingual signs, because the islands were once Danish. Mostly in old downtown areas.

vi-OgDE.title: Roads: loose grid
vi-OgDE.summary: On the southern island, main roads form a loose grid running roughly WSW to ENE, crossed by roads running NNW to SSE. The northern islands have much curvier roads.

vi-QKxC.title: Territory: US overseas islands
vi-QKxC.summary: A group of Caribbean islands that belong to the US. For country streaks they count as the United States.

vi-abU4.title: Google car: red or white, clearly visible
vi-abU4.summary: The Street View car is big and clearly visible, and it is either red or white. Which one depends on the island.

vi-hBRi.title: Google car: white with antenna, short cab
vi-hBRi.summary: A white car with an antenna and a noticeably shorter cab than the other two cars. It only appears on the northern islands.

vi-x3lV.title: Google car: red truck with red cab
vi-x3lV.summary: A red truck with a red cab. It is the most common car on the southern island, which has the most coverage.

vi-yUX7.title: Plate: short, bright or dark blue
vi-yUX7.summary: Short plates with either a bright blue or a dark blue design.
